scope: One fixed H15 label for every actual H10-B entry, no new account/candidate/data.
population: All actual support_entry_H10 BUYs; no selection on surviving to deadline or positive outcome.
target: Same actual BUY date, quantity and fee; decision E+14 close, earliest public MARKET SELL E+15; on suspended/untouched exit keep SELL latched until public fill or cutoff.
baseline: Actual H10 SELL and fees; independently reproduce earliest SELL from E+10 and require exact date/price agreement.
fee: 0.001 each side, actual buy outlay includes buy fee; hypothetical sell proceeds deduct 0.001. No artificial exit fee on right-censored mark.
statistics: For complete paired labels only: n, positive/negative/net increment, mean/median/min/max, mean removing top3/top5; ALL and every entry-year. Retain every censored entry separately, marked without fake sell fee, not mixed into completed-label means.
boundaries: Future outcome label only. Overlapping same-entry positions are not an account; do not sum or compound them as wealth. Does not measure changed entry/quantity/reservation path or annual NAV targets. No H18 label, since capacity excludes it.
